en: Each file is stored privately and checked when it arrives, exactly as a single upload is. Only you and the people you choose to share with can open it.
Each file waits in Needs One Decision, seen only by you, until you choose who it belongs to. We suggest a person only when the name and date of birth in the file match exactly one of your people.

Each one is on or off, and you can change it at any time. Turning one off never requires turning another back on. "Let VisaStack Process My Details" is needed before any traveller or profile can be created; the others are optional.
Each snapshot keeps exactly what this case held when it was taken, newest first.
Embassies usually want this handed in as the original when you apply. Upload a clear scan or photo here so it is ready to share, and keep the original safe.
Every file you add now is saved under this person. You can change this between files.
Every page must show before the safe copy can be saved: {size} of {pageCount} shown so far. Scroll through every page.
Every save keeps the earlier value. You can see them in <Link>History</Link>.
Every section, with every detail you can add, including these.
Everything in the parts you chose, with where each detail came from.
Everything: choosing evidence, submission and outcome, problems, snapshots and the itinerary.
Everything: profile health and the latest changes.
File format is checked when the file is opened. A verified format is not recorded in this metadata view.
File type checked. Not scanned for viruses.
Filed. The file is now being checked and read, as any upload is.
Files for {name} were saved under {name}. Open {name}'s Documents
Folders inside it are included. You do not need to say what each file is first. Each file gets its own line below.
For them to see your details, share them through <Link>Sharing</Link>. They sign in and see only what you share.
Full document numbers are included. Share this copy only with someone who needs them.
Glance: who this is, how complete the profile is, and that you decide what becomes a fact.
Glance: your documents and anything that needs a choice.
Held for safety. It cannot be opened.
Include the List of My Documents
It is a separate copy, checked for safety like any new file. Removing one does not remove the other.
It is filed as {value} and checked before you can choose it.
Keep reusable evidence together. Processing, review and expiry are separate signals.
Keep what is confirmed apart from what is assumed, and check current official requirements before relying on any rule.
Kind, dates and status only. No file is ever included.
Let AI Read Details from My Documents
Let AI Read Text from My Scans
Making your safe copy. This can take up to half a minute.
My Documents: upload a passport page or any file, and sort it out later.
New files are scanned for viruses and cannot be opened until the scan finishes. Each file shows how it was checked.
No snapshots yet. Take one from the case page to keep a copy of this case as it is.
Not checked yet. It cannot be opened.
Not on the list? Add it here. It stays with this section and is saved like any other detail.
Nothing is saved until you accept.
Nothing reaches your profile until you accept it, one detail at a time or all clear ones at once.
Nothing was changed yet: the newer file cannot replace the older one right now. Try again once both files have finished being checked.
On a selected box, arrow keys move it, Shift with an arrow key changes its size, and Delete removes it. Escape stops a box being drawn and lets go of the selected box.
One reusable set of details. Every saved change stays in your history.
Only what the case's checklist asks for, with the sources left out. A case with no checklist shows just the basics.
Open the secure preview below. Permission and current safety are checked again before bytes are served.
Passport and ID numbers show only their last three characters unless you tick this. You will be asked to confirm it is you.
PDF files can be added only while our virus scan is switched on.
Read from a document whose type you have not confirmed yet. Check the date.
Reading a picture shares the picture with an AI service, which is more than text alone. You still accept every detail yourself before it reaches your profile.
Reading with AI is off, so only the file itself was checked.
Reason (Required to Reject or Request a Correction)

Safe copies are not ready yet, so nothing can be saved.
Safe copies are not ready yet.
Saved as a JPG copy of the iPhone photo (HEIC) that was uploaded, so it opens anywhere. The HEIC file itself was not kept.
Select an available row to review its metadata and authorized actions.
Sends scan pictures, not just text, to an AI.
Sharing requires consent, an exact reviewed scope and recipient acceptance. AI suggestions never update your profile until you approve them.
Shown beside your name in your workspace. Only you can see it, and it is never used as a visa photo or shared.
Sized to the published rule (checked {formatCheckedOn}, {sourceTitle}). Check the current rule before submitting. Open the Published Rule
Some documents are still being checked, which can take a few minutes. This page updates by itself, so there is no need to upload them again.
Someone you invited sent this copy, so it is kept.

Stored privately. Only you and the people you choose to share with can open it.

Take a Photo, or Say What Kind of Document It Is
Taken from the document's own text. An AI service picked out the details from that text; the file itself was not sent.

The details you have confirmed, laid out to copy into a form.

These checks are a guide only. They cannot tell you whether the photo will be accepted.
These counts are separate. They are not a score that proves anything. Open a field to see agency reviews and confirmations from issuers.

Only changes that need you are shown here. Every earlier change is kept in <Link>Notifications</Link>.
This is where VisaStack tells you what needs you: a request from an agency, a document close to expiring, a case that moved. Nothing needs you right now.
You never have to open every case to find out what changed.
